title: The Nashville Pinky with Outdoor Movie & Woodfire Pizza Oven
description:
Wanna boot scoot ‘n boogie on down to Music City? Well, we at the Nashville Pinky have been busier than a one-armed paper hanger, gettin’ these magic lil' princess palaces ship shape for all y’all fixin’ to do Nashville right! 

Feel free to ask us any questions!

P.s. For events, photoshoots or filming, send us an inquiry first. Any reservation for events, photoshoots or filming without our consent will be immediately canceled and no refund will be issued.

STR permit number 2/0/1/8/0/4/4/5/8/7

The space
For a stay-cation: Sink into a hot bubble bath with a glass of wine, or movie night with all your Netlix fav's.  Try your hand at a little guitar if inspiration calls, or a sketch pad and some lovingly selected (compliments of The Groove vinyl store) records.

Guest access
Wi-Fi.
Full Kitchen
All appliances
Pillow top queen bed
Sofa bed

Other things to note
We are East Nashvillians of 15 years and have seen this beloved neighborhood and our own historic homes grow and flourish with new energy and color through the years.  We are always very proud and excited to share our favorite place in the world with you!
